title: Additive manufacturing of ductile refractory high-entropy alloys via phase engineering
process_description: prepared by laser melting deposition with optimized parameters: laser power 1350 W, scanning speed 5 mm/s, powder feed rate 4.8 g/min, working distance 14 mm, offset value 0.3 mm, layer number 100.
